verdict.rationale: AI Gateway issues its own team-owned API keys that work across local, CI, external servers and Vercel deployments, plus auto-provisioned OIDC tokens. Provider credentials stay centralized in the gateway via BYOK, so apps never hold raw provider keys. Multiple keys appear to be supported, since requests are summarized and budgets are set per API key. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the key-minting workflow and per-app/per-project key scoping, key rotation/revocation details, and independent hands-on corroboration.
